Track the vertical changes: the amplitude/height is doubled.
State the three transformations: reflection in the $y$-axis, translation by $\begin{pmatrix}-1\\0\end{pmatrix}$, and vertical stretch by scale factor 2.
walkthrough:
Analyze the transformation of key features from $y = f(x)$ to $y = g(x)$:
$$\text{Horizontal reflection and shift: the } x\text{-coordinates change sign and shift left by } 1$$
$$\text{Vertical scale: the } y\text{-coordinates are doubled}$$

State the full sequence of three transformations in correct order:
$$\text{1. Reflection in the } y\text{-axis (giving } y = f(-x)\text{)}$$
$$\text{2. Translation by vector } \begin{pmatrix} -1 \\ 0 \end{pmatrix} \text{ (giving } y = f(-(x + 1)) = f(-x - 1)\text{)}$$
$$\text{3. Stretch with scale factor } 2 \text{ parallel to the } y\text{-axis (giving } y = 2f(-x - 1)\text{)}$$
